source_path: external file supplied with --source to scripts/data-grounding/prepare_cmudict.py
license: CMU permissive license included in LICENSE.txt
observation_unit: dictionary pronunciation entry; alternate pronunciations of one orthographic word are separate related rows
annotation_process: CMUdict 0.7b machine-readable ARPAbet pronunciations and stress marks; see the official repository documentation and symbol table
sampling_and_dependence: resource-defined lexicon census rather than a probability sample; alternate pronunciations share a word and no token frequencies are supplied
original_use: pronunciation lexicon for speech technology; the release is not an experimental paper with a statistical estimand
teaching_simplification: retains every complete phone sequence and derives deterministic phone, vowel, onset, and third-vowel-onset counts
